{
 "cases": [
  {
   "name": "鉴权：不带 Key",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "missing",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 401,
   "expect_code": "missing_api_key"
  },
  {
   "name": "鉴权：Key 无效",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "invalid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 401,
   "expect_code": "invalid_api_key"
  },
  {
   "name": "鉴权：Key 有效",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 200,
   "expect_code": null
  },
  {
   "name": "请求体不是合法 JSON",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": "{'model': 'qwen-mini', 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': '你好'}], 'temperature': 1.5}",
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "invalid_json"
  },
  {
   "name": "模型不存在",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/models",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 404,
   "expect_code": "model_not_found"
  },
  {
   "name": "Key 无权访问模型",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 403,
   "expect_code": "model_not_allowed"
  },
  {
   "name": "模型类型和接口不匹配",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "model_kind_mismatch"
  },
  {
   "name": "max_tokens 大于 4096",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "invalid_parameter"
  },
  {
   "name": "消息里有图片但模型不支持图片",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "image_not_supported"
  },
  {
   "name": "任意消息内容包含拦截词",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "content_filter"
  }
 ]
}
